notes.title: Fixed and new hardware support
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

We have updated our hardware code and FPS Monitor now supports new NVIDIA RTX 3060!

Changelist:
[list]
[*]-Support for new cards NVIDIA RTX 3060, AMD Radeon RX 6800 and RX 6900 series
[*]-Improved monitoring and fixed some sensors on various hardware (CPU, GPU, MB)
[*]-Overlay visibility is saved on a scene change or software shutdown, so if you disabled an overlay and closed the program, it will be invisible on the next start
[*]-Added temperature sensors switch Fahrenheit - Celsius (in Sysinfo extension settings)
[*]-PlayClaw will not show an error message when you start its second instance, now it just activates previously started instance
[*]-A number of Invisible but very important fixes :)
[/list]

notes.title: New Ryzen CPUs support and fixes #5280
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

Hardware access module is updated and now our system information overlay can get some Ryzen 5000 sensors ;)
Other changes:
[list]
[*]Added support for fractional min/max values in sysinfo graphs and bars
[*]Added support for fractional values in alerts settings
[*]Fixed Rainbow 6 crash when Vulkan API is used
[*]Fixed Mount & Blade || - Bannerlord detection
[*]Fixed Armored Warfare detection
[/list]


Do you play R6? We have a good news for you. Unfortunately, R6 devs are blocking 3rd party Vulkan layers (we use our own layer to draw overlays in Vulkan-powered games). But there is a workaround to make our layer "eligible" :)
Open software installation folder and subfolder Tools.

Then open playclawvk64.json in any text editor, find the "name" parameter and change its default value from "VK_LAYER_playclaw" to "VK_LAYER_RENDERDOC_Capture", save the file, run the game.

What we have done? We have changed our layer name to white-listed layer name of RenderDoc software. This software is used by game developers and probably you will not have it and no conflict is expected.

tags.feature: [*]Added support for fractional min/max values in sysinfo graphs and bars
[*]Added support for fractional values in alerts settings

[*]Fixed Mount & Blade || - Bannerlord detection
[*]Fixed Armored Warfare detection

notes.title: Maintenance release #5020
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This new update will give you new features in Sysinfo charts overlay and several fixes.

[h1]Changes list[/h1]
[list]
[*]Sysinfo overlay additions: added alerts, fill charts option (instead of drawing only lines), lines anti-aliasing option
[*]Fixed compatibility with some latest Vulkan-powered games: Strange Brigade, Quake 2 VK
[*]Forza Horizon 4 is now in black list and you can run it with the program without crash, we hope :)
[*]Fixed bug rendering overlay properties window
[*]Added ability to get AMD GPU sensors values from drivers instead of low level access
[*]Fixed bug not auto-scaling overlays if the program is started in minimized mode
[/list]

If you like to use some "non-standard" codecs like MagicYUV or Lagarith, then we have a good news for you.
We've found a 3rd party plugin developed for PlayClaw 6 https://github.com/ignus2/playclaw6-plugin-encoder-vfw which can use built-in Video for Windows codecs.

notes.title: New features in new year
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
We hope you're fine and ready to get new PlayClaw features!
This build #5000 has several changes and tunes in overlays and stability and two major additions:

[h1]New Teamspeak 3 overlays[/h1]
We have splitted old overlay into two new ones: voice chat and text chat to make them better and more functional. Unfortunately Teamspeak 3 team is busy (sorry, we don't know what they do, but our new plugins are already 2 months in review). So you will need to install them manually. It is not a problem, I hope we solved the TS3 puzzle here https://playclaw.com/support/scenes-overlays/overlays/teamspeak3/

[h1]Desktop Widgets[/h1]
Very simple and nice - you can see your overlays over the desktop :)
Easy to install and configure https://playclaw.com/support/plugins/desktop-widgets/

notes.title: We don't like lags! Do you?
notes.content:
We think you don't like too. That is why we worked hard this summer with a new PlayClaw version.
Now it is ready and we hope you will be satisfied ;)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31134530/6eb74bcdfe16127cc0fa8a5b4bc7407a79668f26.png[/img]

Changes list in build 4800:
[list]
[*]Capturing and compression code was tuned to avoid frames drops when a game uses full power of GPU
[*]Better peak system load processing to avoid unwanted frames drops
[*]Fixed bug capturing black screenshots
[*]Added process/date options for screenshots path
[*]Added automatic backup feature after starting new version
[*]Added new Teamspeak 3 options: show speakers and show messages
[*]Added simple interface mode (it is enabled by default on very first software start)
[*]Sysinfo overlays are now loading in delayed mode - they will show "wait" message and will not block software loading during hardware sensors initializing
[*]Overlays will not be removed from a game if PlayClaw is in GAME capture mode and game is minimized
[*]Added video tutorials (check Help menu)
[*]Old Sysinfo overlay was replaced with two new ones: simple and sufficient for most gamers and complex experimental overlay which has everything and a bit more
[*]Added multiselection feature in overlays editor for group moving of overlays
[*]Program user interface is changed to give handy and efficient way to set up scenes
[*]Plugins API is almost ready for release
[/list]

We have lots of plans for future updates and we will try to inform you about these plans and, may be, you'll be even able to vote what feature to add next ;)

[list]

[*]PlayClaw now gets all available Twitch servers from your location on start up
[*]Custom RTMP settings are available now
[*]Fixed compatibility with Quake Champions, GZDoom, Hitman 2016, Stalker
[*]Fixed DirectX 9 games detection on some systems
[*]Fixed cursor rendering while capturing if cursor was hidden by a game
[*]Fixed image loading in Image overlay on Windows 7
[*]Fixed crash on startup if your video hardware is too old (doesn't support DX10/11)
[/list]

notes.title: Output effects feature in this new release!
notes.content:
New build #4400 is ready to download with new feature - output overlays effects.
Effects will change overlay image on output (local file or streaming), not ingame. These effects are done completely on GPU and do not affect your CPU load.

Short video preview with main changes: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hv0zJgL1CMs
[list]
[*]Added overlay output effects: [u]Chroma key[/u], [u]Scrolling[/u]
[*]Added [u]Sysinfo Bar[/u] overlay
[*]Added FPS Lock feature
[*]Added ability to change overlays names (use F2 in overlays list)
[*]Added basic interface layout settings
[*]Fixed NVEnc H.264 failure on some resolutions (1440x900, 1366x768)
[*]Better NVEnc H.264 detection
[*]Fixed bug loading images with alpha channel
[*]Fixed bug getting AMD Ryzen 1500X temperature
[*]Fixed bug starting with AMD Ramdisk running
[/list]

[u]This build changes how overlays can be resized.[/u] If you use a mouse for resize, then original source overlay size will be changed. If you use CTRL button with mouse, then overlay will be scaled.

[i]Do you need overlays effects ingame?[/i] Sorry, it is not possible now. We will come back to this question later, after new year.

[*]Added basic interface layout settings

notes.title: New build #4370 is ready
notes.content:
New PlayClaw version is just released (build #4370) with a number of changes and bug fixes.
[list]
[*]Capture mode setting is moved to application Toolbar
[*]Added game process selection for Game capture mode
[*]Fixed bug with overlays scaling
[*]Fixed Sysinfo overlay blinking
[*]Fixed invisible overlays rendering to output in DX12 games
[*]Fixed audio mixer bug when an audio source stops to produce any data
[/list]
